posts.name: Snail Shell
posts.cooked:
I disagree.  Here's why.

Gaming meetup a couple of weeks ago, the other guys were talking about how much stuff you get in the box with Terra Mystica and how heavy the box was.

WHUDD!!

I drop SotM on the table, getting intimidated looks from the other guys at my table, and 'what was that??' looks from other tables. 

Then I did the same with the second box.  :D

Needless to say, I explained to them what SotM was, why it was so dense and heavy, and then instructed a game where we proudly made Ambuscade cry uncle.

The stares of awe are WAY too much fun to pack this whole game into one box.  :)

posts.name: Renkenr
posts.cooked:
Now try fitting everything into the boxes after you sleeve your cards.

Had to remove part of the insert to the EE box and they still didn't fit. 1/4th of a millimeter over. RC/IR was perfect for holding sleeved cards. The Vengence box has a lot of space wasted on the oversized cards holder area, but holds sleeved cards perfectly in the normal card areas.

 

(side bar: yes. I sleeve. Having destroyed cards from use in CCGs because we didn't know any better in 1994 and now seeing those cards values... That's why I sleeve. If you don't sleeve that's your choice. I love SotM and I want to keep my cards around for a looong time. Glad it's not a CCG!)
